data.gender_notes: Amamah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Amamah is derived from the Arabic word ‘Amm’ meaning ‘mother’s sister’ or ‘aunt’. This name holds a special place in Islamic culture as it reflects the strong bonds of love and respect between family members. The name Amamah carries the meaning “Mother's sister” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amamah usually hope their child will grow to embody mother's sister and live with faith, good character and purpose.
